newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's Grajewo wood firm prices issue at PLN 90.
newsitem.headline: Poland's Grajewo wood firm prices issue at PLN 90.

text.p: Polish chipboard maker Zaklady Plyt Wiorowych w Grajewie SA (Grajewo) set the issue price of its 550,000-share initial public offering at 90 zlotys per share, the head of the issue's lead manager said on Friday.
"We have set the issue price at 90 zlotys that is the top of the planned price range," Wolfgang Bauer, the president of Creditanstalt Securities, told a news conference.
Earlier the company set the price range for the issue's bookbuilding at 75-90 zlotys per share.
He said Creditanstalt had also set an underwriting consortium of nine institutions which agreed to underwrite the entire offering scheduled for January 20-24.

Grajewo said in a statement Creditanstalt Securities would underwrite 194,000 shares, Creditanstalt Investmentbank AG 170,000 shares. UBS Ltd, IMI Sigeco Ltd, Bank Rozwoju Eksportu, Powszechny Bank Kredytowy, Bank Handlowy securities house and Pekao SA 30,000 guaranteed 30,000 shares each and Penetrator brokerage underwrote 6,000 shares.

The firm, which seeks listing on the main market, offers 260,000 shares on January 20-21 in a tranche for large investors, 90,000 for small investors on January 20-24 and 200,000 shares for current shareholders on January 20-24.

It said it estimated its net profit at 19.2 million zlotys and sales at 232.9 million zlotys in 1996 and expected them to rise to 20.3 million and 266.3 million zlotys respectively in 1997. Last year Grajewo had a net profit of 12.4 million zlotys on sales of 195.7 million zlotys.
